source_note: Absolute Kenya Shillings (KSh). 2024 comparative restated as printed. | 1 previously blank cell(s) filled on 2026-09-27 from Shri Krishana Overseas PLC financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025; see cell_sources. H1 2026 column transcribed from SHRI KRISHANA OVERSEAS PLC unaudited results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (page 1 of skl.co.ke/half-year-results-2026.pdf); revenue + cost of sales = gross profit ties exactly, and PAT and EPS match the document's own highlights. That column is HALF-YEAR and UNAUDITED - the FY2025 and FY2024 columns are annual. FY2025/FY2024 EPS corrected 2026-10-02: the issuer's printed annual EPS (4.10 / 10.07) implies about 1,010,000 shares, but the company listed 50,500,000 shares of KES 0.20 (prospectus / NSE listing 24 Jul 2025; share capital 10,100,000 unchanged) and its own H1 2026 filing prints EPS 0.083 on PAT 4,209,340. The annual EPS is therefore PAT / 50,500,000, computed, not the printed figure. | CRON 20261004_1032: blank cell filled from the file's own duplicate statement row carrying the same line under an issuer label (validated Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit). | CRON 20261004_1040: Net Finance Costs for H1 2026 filled from the file's own Finance Costs row, which carries the identical value and sign on the two periods both rows cover.
